title.zh: South Africa’s Second-Largest Bank FNB Launches Crypto Trading With VALR
title.en: South Africa’s Second-Largest Bank FNB Launches Crypto Trading With VALR

current_state.zh: First National Bank, part of South Africa's second-largest banking group, launched a 24/7 crypto investing service through its existing share-trading platform in partnership with licensed local exchange VALR, offering BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL and USDT from as little as R10.
current_state.en: First National Bank, part of South Africa's second-largest banking group, launched a 24/7 crypto investing service through its existing share-trading platform in partnership with licensed local exchange VALR, offering BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL and USDT from as little as R10.
